notLegalAdviceNotice.value: This privacy notice is an implementation draft for website operations. It is not legal advice. Alberta PIPA and CASL obligations should be confirmed with qualified counsel before publish.

controller.notes: Legal entity that controls personal information (confirm vs brand name)

contact.notes: Privacy contact email/mail address for access, correction, complaints

purposes.notes: Respond to Fit Call inquiries; optional marketing with separate consent; site security/spam; language preference

processors.notes: Hostinger hosting, WPForms/SMTP or successor intake provider, any CRM — list legal names once confirmed

locations.notes: Storage/processing regions (Canada / US / other) for host, email, backups

retention.notes: Inquiry retention period; mailbox; form entries; backups; marketing list

accessCorrection.notes: How individuals request access or correction under PIPA

safeguards.notes: HTTPS, access controls, redacted logs, staff handling rules

breaches.notes: Incident response and notification approach — counsel to confirm PIPA thresholds

deletion.notes: How to request deletion / marketing unsubscribe handling

marketing.notes: CASL: express consent, identification, unsubscribe — separate from Fit Call response consent

cookiesAndStorage.value: Functional language preference may be stored in your browser (localStorage key geez_lang_pref). Non-essential analytics or marketing scripts do not load until you opt in (geez_script_consent_v1).
